Name: Voice Dialogue AI
Author: Pumkin114514
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3]Voice Dialogue AI is a revolutionary mod that lets you [b]actually talk to NPCs with your voice[/b]. Hold down a key, speak naturally, and an AI will generate dynamic, unique responses based on each NPC's personality, current mood, and in-game context — including weather, season, time of day, location, and festivals.[/size]
[size=3]Every NPC feels truly alive. They have their own personality, hobbies, family background, and catchphrases. They remember what you've said, they get happy or angry based on your words, they chat about the rain on a rainy day, and they wish you happy holidays during festivals. No more clicking through the same fixed dialogue options — say whatever you want, and get a real response.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Step 1: Install SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Download SMAPI from smapi.io[/size]
[size=3]• Run the installer and follow the prompts[/size]
[size=3]• Launch the game through SMAPI after installation[/size]

[size=3][b]Step 2: Install the Mod[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Download the mod zip file[/size]
[size=3]2. Extract the zip[/size]
[size=3]3. Copy the VoiceDialogueAI folder into your game's Mods directory[/size]
[size=3]4. Verify: Mods\VoiceDialogueAI\VoiceDialogueMod.dll[/size]

[size=3][b]Step 3: Configure Your API Key (Dialogue AI)[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Open Mods\VoiceDialogueAI\config.json[/size]
[size=3]2. Find OpenAiApiKey and enter your API key[/size]
[size=3]Recommended: DeepSeek (affordable, great for Chinese)[/size]
[size=3]• Sign up at platform.deepseek.com[/size]
[size=3]• Ensure ChatBaseUrl = https://api.deepseek.com/v1[/size]
[size=3]• Ensure ChatModel = deepseek-chat[/size]

[size=3][b]Step 4: Install Local Speech Recognition (Free Option, Optional)[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Install Python 3.10+ (check "Add Python to PATH")[/size]
[size=3]2. Go to Mods\VoiceDialogueAI[/size]
[size=3]3. Double-click "安装本地依赖.bat" (Install Local Dependencies)[/size]
[size=3]4. Verify in config.json: SpeechBaseUrl = http://localhost:8081/v1, AutoStartLocalServer = true[/size]

[size=3][b]Step 5: Launch the Game[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI[/size]
[size=3]• Look for "[VoiceDialogueAI] === Voice Dialogue AI Mod Loaded ===" in console[/size]
[size=3]• Hold V to talk to NPCs![/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]🎙️ True Voice Conversation[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Hold V to record, release to auto-transcribe[/size]
[size=3]• Free local Whisper speech recognition (GPU-accelerated)[/size]
[size=3]• Smart clarification popup when transcription may be wrong[/size]

[size=3][b]🧠 AI-Powered Dynamic Responses[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Large language model generates unique replies every time[/size]
[size=3]• Built-in personality profiles for 30+ NPCs[/size]
[size=3]• NPCs have persistent memory — they remember your conversations[/size]

[size=3][b]😊 Real Emotion System[/b][/size]
[size=3]• 8 emotion states: Happy, Shy, Angry, Surprised, Sad, Loving, Bored, Neutral[/size]
[size=3]• AI automatically infers emotion changes from responses[/size]
[size=3]• Emotions affect tone and content of subsequent dialogue[/size]

[size=3][b]🌤️ Immersive Contextual Dialogue[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Festival dialogue (Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Fair, Winter Star, etc.)[/size]
[size=3]• Weather, seasonal, time, and location-aware conversations[/size]
[size=3]• NPCs mention your farming level, mine depth, and achievements[/size]

[size=3][b]🎁 Interactive Item Trading[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Request or buy items from NPCs[/size]
[size=3]• Each NPC has profession-based inventory[/size]
[size=3]• Friendship affects pricing (0 hearts = full price, 10 hearts = up to 40% off)[/size]
[size=3]• At 5+ hearts, NPCs may give items for free[/size]

[size=3][b]⚙️ Full In-Game Configuration[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Complete Generic Mod Config Menu support[/size]
[size=3]• 50+ config options editable in-game[/size]
[size=3]• Organized into 5 pages[/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Required:[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/size]
[size=3]• SMAPI 4.0 or later[/size]

[size=3][b]Optional but Highly Recommended:[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Generic Mod Config Menu — for in-game configuration[/size]

[size=3][b]Local Speech Recognition (Optional, for Free Setup):[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Python 3.10 or later[/size]
[size=3]• NVIDIA GPU (optional, for GPU-accelerated recognition)[/size]

[size=3][b]Notes:[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Internet connection required for dialogue AI (unless using local model like Ollama)[/size]
[size=3]• First launch downloads a speech model (~several hundred MB)[/size]
[size=3]• This mod does not modify save files[/size]
